facts.summary: FDA maintains clinical hold, more data needed; trial timelines reassessed · Phase 1 · CTI-1601 in Friedreich's ataxia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: FDA stated it is maintaining its clinical hold at this time and that additional data is needed to resolve the clinical hold.
evidence.safety: No serious adverse events, important medical events, or treatment-related severe adverse events were reported in the trial
evidence.program_discontinued: We remain committed to CTI-1601’s further development and are working towards this goal with a strong cash position which provides runway at least into 2023.
